name: TC-870: @scenario S8 Chain combo built in the chain shell — the fan-out confirm, then the member location's lima and wind offer and price it
description: Chain menu: a per-run chain category with Wrap ($9) and Drink ($3). Build in the chain shell: Create promotion → Combo price → Wrap + Drink, $10.49 → Save and turn on asks 'Heads up — chain-wide change … This will affect all N locations' → Continue. Read back (chain list + deal): owned by the chain group, the two lines, $10.49. Edit in the chain shell: price → $10.99 (the confirm again). Location A on lima (the chain's slug → the location picker → Order here at A) and wind (?restaurantId=A) list it in Today's Deals; building it prices $10.99 at checkout, You're saving = $12 − $10.99.
